name: Keep Park Kill
tagline: Grades saved links and launches against your written goals
description: Feed it the tools, launches and articles piling up in your reading list and it scores each one against the goals you have written down. Every item comes back filed as keep, park or kill, maybes get a revisit date, and it stays silent unless something clears the bar.
author: the_Arow_H
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
